_doc: Argument knobs the live tool registry SHIPS that the tool's arguments model does not carry, each with a checkable reason. Read by tests/unit/web/composer/test_tool_model_wire_parity.py, which fails on a fence row that is no longer a gap: a fence must not outlive what it fences, so a tool that gains its model retires its own rows here by turning this file red. Every row below is PROVISIONAL — the Seam 1 verdicts are ratified (elspeth-54bd0b84cd, 2026-09-08) but each remedy either changes what the wire accepts, changes an error surface the planner reads, or is entangled with the redaction-policy question Seam 3 settles for the five no-policy tools, so none may be applied before John rules. A row is retired by implementing its verdict, never by widening the gate.

clear_source.source_name: PROVISIONAL (awaiting John): fix_producer — add source_name (str, min_length 1, default 'source') to a handler-local _ClearSourceArgumentsModel validated at the top of _execute_clear_source, and delete the hand-rolled extra-key set-difference and type()-is-str check at sources.py:2098-2110 (a hand-listed inventory beside the live schema). No public-path acceptance change: the closed json-schema (required [], additionalProperties False) already rejects extras and non-strings before dispatch. John rules because deriving known_argument_keys from model fields is a redaction-policy change.

delete_blob.blob_id: PROVISIONAL (awaiting John): fix_producer — add blob_id: str to a handler-local _DeleteBlobArgumentsModel validated at the top of _execute_delete_blob, replacing the raw arguments['blob_id'] read at blobs.py:1890. Keep str, NOT the owned UUID type: a malformed id is deliberately routed through _blob_id_uuid_validation_error (an @observation_boundary whose stated invariant is that it never raises) onto the repairable _failure_result channel, and a UUID-typed field would move it to ToolArgumentError — a shipped error-surface change. Do not reuse GetBlobContentArgumentsModel: by AST it has zero model_validate readers in src, so copying it copies a dead wire. No public-path acceptance change.

explain_validation_error.error_text: PROVISIONAL (awaiting John): fix_producer — add error_text: str to an _ExplainValidationErrorArgumentsModel validated at the top of _execute_explain_validation_error (generation.py:1819-1821 hands the raw value straight to re.search). Today the only guard is the dispatch-time closed schema, and this tool has no allowlist either (known_argument_keys=(), redact_unknown=False), so the model would be its first typed admission. John rules this row together with Seam 3 Task 3.6's ADMITTED disposition for the same five no-policy tools.

get_blob_metadata.blob_id: PROVISIONAL (awaiting John): fix_producer — add blob_id: str to a handler-local _GetBlobMetadataArgumentsModel validated once at the top of _handle_get_blob_metadata, which subscripts the raw mapping twice (blobs.py:431, :434) with no shape check between the closed schema and _sync_get_blob. Keep str for the same error-channel reason as delete_blob, and do not bind the MANIFEST's GetBlobContentArgumentsModel: it is validated by no handler, so binding it here would mean a new MANIFEST entry, which is a redaction-policy change. No public-path acceptance change.

get_pipeline_state.component: PROVISIONAL (awaiting John): fix_producer — add component: str | None = None to a _GetPipelineStateArgumentsModel. sessions.py:2172 args.get('component') is the only .get read across all registered handlers and is the soft-guard shape this seam names. Do NOT enum the aliases: node ids and output names are open strings, so the alias set stays a semantic check at :2174-2200. No public-path acceptance change (pinned by test_tool_dispatch_boundary.py); John rules because this tool has no allowlist, which Seam 3 Task 3.6 settles.

get_plugin_assistance.issue_code: PROVISIONAL (awaiting John): fix_producer — add issue_code: str | None = None to one _GetPluginAssistanceArgumentsModel. NOT a Literal: by AST 59 get_agent_assistance implementations each own their plugin's codes (the observed corpus includes 'line_explode.source_field.line_framed_text'), so a closed vocabulary would reject real calls. The shipped schema already says type ['string','null']. No acceptance change; John rules with the rest of this tool's row set.
get_plugin_assistance.plugin_name: PROVISIONAL (awaiting John): fix_producer — add plugin_name: str to the same _GetPluginAssistanceArgumentsModel, replacing the raw arguments['plugin_name'] read at generation.py:1947. The policy check stays where it is, in _validate_plugin_name (:1962). No acceptance change.
get_plugin_assistance.plugin_type: PROVISIONAL (awaiting John): fix_producer — add plugin_type as a shared PluginKind Literal['source','transform','sink'] on the same model and DELETE the hand-rolled `plugin_type_raw not in (...)` arm at generation.py:1955-1959, which duplicates the schema enum by hand. Type get_plugin_schema.plugin_type from the same Literal so the two schema enums and both models are one fact (precedent: secrets.py:76-82, whose else-arm went dead once the enum was lifted into a Literal). No acceptance change.

get_plugin_schema.name: PROVISIONAL (awaiting John): fix_producer — add name: str to a _GetPluginSchemaArgumentsModel, replacing the raw arguments['name'] read at generation.py:253. This is the most-called gap tool in the observed corpus and name is always set. No acceptance change.
get_plugin_schema.plugin_type: PROVISIONAL (awaiting John): fix_producer — add plugin_type on the shared PluginKind Literal (see get_plugin_assistance.plugin_type) to the same model, validated at the top of _handle_get_plugin_schema. Once it lands, narrow the `except (ValueError, KeyError)` arm at generation.py:259-262 to ValueError: its 'LLM omitted required argument' comment is unreachable on public paths (the closed schema and _TOOL_REQUIRED_PATHS at tool_batch.py:1061-1064 both run first), so the KeyError arm is a soft guard standing in for the model. No acceptance change.

list_models.limit: PROVISIONAL (awaiting John): fix_producer — add limit: int = 50 with ge=1 AND lift into the json-schema the two facts the code carries but the schema does not: default 50 and minimum 1 (the live property has neither). Today limit=0, -5 or true are ACCEPTED and silently rewritten to 50 at generation.py:2159-2161 — a knob that does nothing, with no error signal. Closing it turns an out-of-range limit into a schema rejection, so this CHANGES ACCEPTANCE and John rules on the merits. He also decides the open question the code does not answer: whether limit, which controls response size and has no cap today, gains an upper bound (le).
list_models.provider: PROVISIONAL (awaiting John): fix_producer — add provider: str | None = None to a _ListModelsArgumentsModel. NOT an enum against the provider registry: provider is a PREFIX FILTER, not a vocabulary — the handler rstrips '/', special-cases 'openrouter/' and '' and otherwise uses startswith (generation.py:2163-2175), and the observed corpus sends 'openrouter/'. A vocabulary would reject real calls. The model closes the silent ignore of a non-str provider on non-public paths; on public paths the closed schema already rejects non-strings, so no acceptance change.

request_advisor_hint.attempted_actions: PROVISIONAL (awaiting John): fix_producer — add attempted_actions as a list of length-capped strings (item cap _ADVISOR_LIST_ITEM_MAX_CHARS, list cap _ADVISOR_ATTEMPTED_ACTIONS_MAX_ITEMS) on the one _RequestAdvisorHintArgumentsModel, and derive the schema's maxItems/maxLength from those constants: 8 and 2000 are written by hand in both service.py:465-466 and _dispatch.py:183-185 with nothing tying them together. See the trigger row for the locus and John's question. Sensitive key: the redaction MANIFEST entry must not change.
request_advisor_hint.problem_summary: PROVISIONAL (awaiting John): fix_producer — add problem_summary: str with max_length=_ADVISOR_PROBLEM_SUMMARY_MAX_CHARS on the same model, replacing the isinstance/len ladder at service.py:7239-7251, and derive the schema's maxLength from the constant (2000 written by hand at service.py:462 and _dispatch.py:165). See the trigger row. Sensitive key: redaction unchanged.
request_advisor_hint.recent_errors: PROVISIONAL (awaiting John): fix_producer — add recent_errors as a list of length-capped strings (item cap _ADVISOR_LIST_ITEM_MAX_CHARS, list cap _ADVISOR_RECENT_ERRORS_MAX_ITEMS), replacing the list/str/len ladder at service.py:7253-7271; caps 5 and 2000 are hand-duplicated at service.py:464,466 and _dispatch.py:174-176. See the trigger row. Sensitive key: redaction unchanged.
request_advisor_hint.schema_excerpt: PROVISIONAL (awaiting John): fix_producer — add schema_excerpt: str | None = None with max_length=_ADVISOR_SCHEMA_EXCERPT_MAX_CHARS, AND resolve a type disagreement while doing it: the shipped schema says type 'string' (not nullable) while the hand validator explicitly admits None (service.py:7293-7306), and because the closed schema never runs for this tool, null is accepted on the wire today. The remedy is to make the schema say ['string','null'] so SHIPPED matches what is admitted — that WIDENS AN ADVERTISED TYPE, a surface change John rules on the merits. Cap 8000 hand-duplicated at service.py:463 and _dispatch.py:196.
request_advisor_hint.trigger: PROVISIONAL (awaiting John): fix_producer — add trigger as a Literal derived from ADVISOR_TRIGGER_VALUES on a new _RequestAdvisorHintArgumentsModel(extra='forbid'), and delete _ADVISOR_ARGUMENT_KEYS (service.py:453-460, a hand copy of the schema's property names) together with the per-key isinstance ladder. HIGHEST-PRIORITY ROW: this is the one knob-bearing tool the closed json-schema NEVER validates — tool_batch.py:1613 intercepts the call before execute_tool, and by AST the only callers of _validate_tool_arguments are _dispatch.py:761/:852 and composer_mcp/server.py:367/:795, none on this path — so the hand ladder is today's ONLY enforcement of type, enum, maxLength and maxItems. LOCUS matters: the model and a validate-only function must live under tools/ (beside ADVISOR_TRIGGER_VALUES in tools/sessions.py, which service.py already imports from) with _validate_advisor_arguments calling it, so this census derives the row by the same call-shape rule and not by a hand-named exception. Keep the ARG_ERROR payload envelope (status/error/error_class) exactly; the settings-derived prompt-size cap and anti-anchor accounting stay outside the model. JOHN DECIDES: whether the per-field error TEXT may become pydantic's messages or must be mapped back to the current hand strings, which the planner reads in its repair loop. Sensitive keys: the redaction MANIFEST entry must not change.

wire_blob_inline_ref.blob_id: PROVISIONAL (awaiting John): fix_producer — add blob_id: str to a _WireBlobInlineRefArgumentsModel, replacing the two raw reads at blobs.py:644 and :647. Keep str, not UUID, so a malformed id stays on _blob_id_uuid_validation_error's repairable _failure_result channel (same reason as delete_blob); the schema's format 'uuid' is advisory in Draft 2020-12. No acceptance change.
wire_blob_inline_ref.encoding: PROVISIONAL (awaiting John): fix_producer — add encoding: ContentEncoding = 'utf-8', the existing Literal the cast at blobs.py:662 already targets, so the model, the cast's target and the schema enum sorted(ALLOWED_CONTENT_ENCODINGS) at :735 become one authority (pin get_args(ContentEncoding) == ALLOWED_CONTENT_ENCODINGS with a probe). Delete the hand-rolled type()-is-not-str plus membership pair at :657-661 and the cast at :662; the eight-line comment at :649-656 defending the check ordering describes exactly the crash class the model removes. No acceptance change: 'utf-8' is already the schema default.
wire_blob_inline_ref.field_path: PROVISIONAL (awaiting John): fix_producer — add field_path: str on a _WireBlobInlineRefArgumentsModel(extra='forbid') validated at the top of _execute_wire_blob_inline_ref (the handler is raw-read-only today, with seven literal subscripts); the canonical-path grammar stays in BlobInlineRef at :680-687. CONSEQUENCE JOHN MUST RULE ON: extra='forbid' makes the hidden sha256_override read at blobs.py:676 unwritable, so the honest close deletes that read — a READ-not-SHIPPED knob deletion and Seam 2 material. It is already unreachable on every public path (declared additionalProperties False plus _closed_root_schema), so the model only makes an existing fact structural, but deleting the read is a decision, not a refactor.
